suggested_change: Clarify: (1) Carry-forward scores require explicit contradictory evidence from new call data to regress; absence of fresh confirmation ≠ regression. (2) Define when a 'first call' vs. 'cumulative call 4' scoring mode applies—if cumulative, prior evidence stands unless overridden. (3) For vague next steps (Criterion 4), specify whether '[TBD]' placeholders are acceptable or require concrete dates/names in the call itself.
